_readme: Plain-words rules file read by the radar code (Node: src/radar/rules.js, Python: radar/radar_rules.py). Edit this file to change rules - no code change needed. Every hazard says which official body is responsible and how well we verified that. Anything marked 'NOT CONFIRMED' must be checked by a person against the primary page before it is shown to judges as fact.

publish_rule.explain: An alert found by the radar is published straight away ONLY if its web address is https and ends in .gov.in or .nic.in. Everything else waits as 'pending' until an officer approves it.
force_pending_if: severity could not be worked out

severity.explain: How the radar turns an agency colour code or words into our four levels.

earthquake_magnitude_bands.label: TEAM RULE - not an official NCS scale. Change if the team prefers.

dedupe.explain: The same alert found twice must not create two rows. Key = hazard | district | source host | day. A re-fetch updates the old row.

cyclone.label: Cyclone
cyclone.official_agency: India Meteorological Department (IMD) - RSMC Cyclones, New Delhi
cyclone.advice: Move to the nearest cyclone shelter. Stay indoors away from windows.

flood.label: Flood
flood.official_agency: Central Water Commission (CWC) flood forecasts; state flood control rooms
flood.advice: Move to higher ground. Do not walk or drive through flood water.

heavy_rain.label: Heavy rainfall
heavy_rain.notified_status: Weather warning product (not a separate notified disaster)

cloudburst.label: Cloudburst / flash flood
cloudburst.verification: PARTLY CONFIRMED - NOT CONFIRMED which exact IMD product carries cloudburst alerts
cloudburst.advice: Move away from streams and gullies to higher ground.

lightning.label: Lightning / thunderstorm
lightning.notified_status: NOT CONFIRMED on a primary page - only a secondary news report said it is notified
lightning.verification: NEEDS PRIMARY CHECK of notified status
lightning.advice: Go indoors. Stay away from trees, poles and open fields.

tsunami.label: Tsunami
tsunami.official_agency: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS) - Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre
tsunami.advice: Move inland and to high ground immediately.

earthquake.label: Earthquake
earthquake.official_agency: National Center for Seismology (NCS), Ministry of Earth Sciences
earthquake.advice: Drop, cover and hold on. After shaking stops move to an open area.

landslide.label: Landslide
landslide.official_agency: Geological Survey of India (GSI) - landslide forecasting; IMD rain warnings
landslide.verification: PARTLY CONFIRMED - GSI forecasting rollout described in future tense on one page; check current status
landslide.advice: Move away from the slope path. Avoid hill roads during heavy rain.

avalanche.label: Avalanche
avalanche.official_agency: Defence Geoinformatics Research Establishment (DGRE), DRDO - NOT CONFIRMED, inferred from SACHET source list
avalanche.notified_status: Notified disaster (SDRF list: 'snow avalanche' - check exact wording)
avalanche.advice: Stay away from steep snowy slopes. Follow local army and police advisories.

heatwave.label: Heatwave
heatwave.notified_status: NOT CONFIRMED on a primary page - only a secondary report (Down To Earth) says it was notified
heatwave.verification: NEEDS PRIMARY CHECK of notified status
heatwave.advice: Stay indoors in the afternoon, drink water often.

cold_wave.label: Cold wave
cold_wave.verification: PARTLY CONFIRMED - product details not confirmed
cold_wave.advice: Stay warm and indoors. Check on elderly and homeless people.

hailstorm.label: Hailstorm
hailstorm.verification: PARTLY CONFIRMED - product details not confirmed
hailstorm.advice: Take shelter indoors. Protect vehicles and crops if possible.

forest_fire.label: Forest fire
forest_fire.official_agency: Forest Survey of India (FSI) - fire alerts; state forest departments
forest_fire.verification: Agency verified via FSI Van Agni & SACHET
forest_fire.advice: Move away from fire and smoke. Follow evacuation orders.

drought.label: Drought
drought.official_agency: Ministry of Agriculture (Drought Management) / IMD seasonal outlook
drought.verification: Slow-onset: a daily radar is not suitable
drought.advice: Conserve water. Follow district water-supply advisories.
